title: Senior/Principal Facilities Engineering Project Manager, Onsite
description:
About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

  • Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
  • Extraordinary co-workers
  • Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
  • Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
  • Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov


*These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like

We are seeking a hardworking and highly motivated Facilities Engineering Project Manager to join our team. The selected applicant will Lead project teams of internal or external engineering and architectural personnel, construction contractors, customers, sponsors, and suppliers, to ensure that the project meets scope, schedule, and cost requirements per DOE Orders and Sandia's requirements.

On any given day, you may be called on to:

  • Use your relevant technical knowledge to participate in making technical contributions to the project through gathering and developing the customer's technical requirements and providing assurance and constructability reviews
  • Work closely with the project team to ensure that the project progresses as planned and identifies and addresses both technical and non-technical risks, opportunities, and other issues that impact the project during the project execution phase
  • Ensure that projects are completed within budget constraints using cost estimation, budget determination, and cost control and effectively address budget concerns with the appropriate funding source
  • Manage task definition and sequencing, duration estimation, and schedule development and control to ensure that the project is completed on schedule
  • Develop and deliver proposals, requirements documentation, progress reports, process improvements, and presentations for all levels of customers and partners, both internal and external

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite at the Livermore, CA facility.

Applicants on this requisition may be interviewed by multiple organizations at Sandia National Laboratories.

Salary Range

$121,900 - $237,800

*Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require

  • Bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering, or other relevant field plus five or more years of directly related experience; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
  • Experience performing architecture or engineering design on building systems
  • Experience with one or more facilities management processes such as: operations, maintenance, document and project management
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance

Qualifications We Desire

  • Master's degree in architecture, engineering, or other relevant field
  • Certification as a Professional Engineer (PE), Leader in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED), Certified Energy Manager (CEM), and / or Project Management Professional (PMP)
  • Demonstrated advanced computer technical skills including experience with a computerized scheduling system and AutoCAD
  • 5+ years of experience leading teams or programs
  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with all levels of staff and management

About Our Team

The Project and Construction Management Department is responsible for managing, executing, and inspecting all construction projects at the CA site. This includes modification of buildings, space, and infrastructure systems as well as the design and construction of new facilities to satisfy changing programmatic needs.

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Security Clearance

Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

EEO

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

NNSA Requirements for MedPEDs

If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

title: Revenue & Pricing Analyst
description:
Summary

The Revenue & Pricing Analyst supports NYPA's revenue recovery and supply pricing functions through the development and maintenance of cost-of-service studies, revenue analyses, cost recovery mechanisms, and electric commodity pricing models. The position analyzes financial, operational, and market data to ensure accurate cost allocation, rate development, and revenue recovery for NYPA's governmental and business customers.Working closely with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Legal, Customer Solutions, and Operations teams, the Revenue & Pricing Analyst contributes to the execution of rate-setting processes, customer affordability assessments, market competitiveness analyses, and regulatory support activities. The role helps ensure that NYPA's pricing methodologies and cost recovery mechanisms remain financially sound, transparent, and aligned with contractual, regulatory, and market requirements while supporting NYPA's mission of providing reliable and affordable energy services. #LI-CJ1

Responsibilities

  • Maintain existing and support the development of any new NYPA governmental and business customer cost-of-service (COS) studies and commodity rate models
  • Provide support with developing any new cost recovery methods and run the existing monthly cost recovery reconciliations, including governmental Energy Charge Adjustment (ECA) processes. Analyze the ECA results for reporting to internal and external customers.
  • Collaborate in the execution of the rate setting processes, inclusive of performing impact analysis on costumer bills, gathering rate assumptions and inputs, developing supporting rate data, and verifying rate outputs for accuracy
  • Analyze and validate proper costs assessment to customers, including those assessed through cost-of-service and ECAs
  • Validate and issue for billing governmental customer Con Ed delivery rates and surcharges
  • Develop customer savings/cost comparison by using existing market analysis models, including gathering internal requirements, setting up monthly rate inputs and adjusting the models to appropriately reflect electric market conditions in NYS
  • Provide support with the preparation of various COS and rate related Trustee items
  • Publish and maintain the accuracy of the rates stored in the SAP billing system, as well as internal and external rate data postings
  • Stay abreast of rate filings and research rate setting trends in public and private utilities, including NYS CES initiatives as they affect customer costs
  • Assist with development of NYPA’s Annual Transmission Revenue Requirement, including collecting and analyzing data for accuracy within NYPA for the inputs into the process and monthly NTAC calculations

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Basic knowledge of the utility industry and NYISO market is required
  • Intermediate knowledge of economics, finance and accounting concepts and theories
  • Excellent analytical skills required, including the ability to perform statistical and quantitative analysis
  • Ability to interpret and analyze financial, marketing, and utility tariff data
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including functions such as: pivot tables/charts, advanced sorting, VLOOKUP, match, offset, data linking to Access databases, import of data from Excel, CSV and other flat file formats. Excel test will be given at interview.
  • Experience with SAP, Power BI, SQL, Access databases, or similar analytical and reporting tools is preferred
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills. Ability to clearly explain and present concepts in multiple areas of expertise to peers.
  • Ability to anticipate problems/issues, streamline and propose solutions as appropriate is required
  • Ability to work in a team environment is required
  • Ability to assure quality control in all functions of responsibility
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously is required

Education, Experience and Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Accounting, Math or related discipline
  • Minimum of 2 years of related analytical experience preferred
  • Utility pricing and market analysis experience is preferred

Physical Requirements

Up to 25% travel primarily within NY State

The New York Power Authority is committed to providing fair, competitive, and market-informed compensation. The estimated salary range for this position is: $81,000-$101,000. The salary offered will be determined based on the successful candidates’ relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities.

title: NGL Field Technician, Midland
description:
Phillips 66 & YOU - Together we can fuel the future

What to Expect

The Field Technician is responsible for operational, mechanical, and instrument/electrical functions, such as inspection, calibration, troubleshooting, repair, and replacement of equipment to ensure safe and reliable operations. This work includes such activities as supervising/directing field crews, maintaining pipelines in compliance with contracts, regulations, and safety considerations, coordinating with on-site contractors, and ensuring cost effective and safe operations. Employee(s) in this position may have some environmental or safety activities associated with their responsibilities.

The schedule for this position is Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. and participates in a rotating on-call schedule every five weeks.

*This position requires the successful completion of an online assessment. If you meet the required qualifications of the position, a link to complete the assessment will be emailed to you immediately after your completed application is received. Please check your spam folder if you do not see the email. The assessment must be completed within 7 days of your application date OR prior to the job posting expiration date (November 23, 2026), whichever is earlier. The job posting expiration date is listed at the bottom of this job posting. Your assessment results will be valid for one year.

What You’ll Do

  • Maintain, calibrate, troubleshoot, inspect, and repair of end devices and electrical equipment.
  • Conducts routine inspection of equipment and facilities (equipment health, security, AVO- Audio, Visual, Olfactory), operation of natural gas liquid pump and meter stations (to include mainline valves)
  • Conducts pipeline pigging, filter changes, and I LI tool runs, etc.
  • Responsible for Startup, Shutdown, and operating NGL equipment
  • Performing and providing technical support for installations, maintenance, and repairs of mechanical, electrical, and rotating equipment
  • Performing planned maintenance checks and calibration and timely submits appropriate reports.
  • Reading and understanding P&ID's
  • Maintaining l&E skills by attending training sessions and on-the-job training
  • Maintains pipeline ROW such as markers, signs, and vegetation, exposures
  • Maintains One-Call - Pipeline Locating, encroachment, excavation & crossing
  • Maintains records in accordance with Pipeline regulatory requirements
  • Conducts routine inspection, calibration and repair of meter and associated equipment (measurement meter, ultrasonic meter, flow computer)
  • Assist with pulling composite samples and proving measurement meters.
  • Performs maintenance and repair of mechanical equipment such as block valves, control valves, air compressors, manual valve actuators, etc.
  • Performs maintenance and repair of and fixed equipment such as filters (all types), strainers, dehydration systems, etc.
  • Conducts routine inspection, such as transmitters, switches, fire eyes, hazardous gas detection, level detection, etc.
  • Operate PLC, HMI equipment, software, pipeline valves and actuators
  • Maintain and repair motor control equipment

What You’ll Bring – Required

  • Legally authorized to work in the job posting country
  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Currently live or be willing to relocate to within 35 miles of the reporting locations
  • 3 or more years of operations experience in the Oil & Gas or related industry
  • Maintain a valid driver’s license
  • Willing and able to with or without reasonable accommodations:
    • Lift a minimum of 50 pounds
    • Occasionally exerts pulling force of 130 pounds
    • Occasionally climb A-frame ladders, including heights up to 45 feet for tank service
    • Regularly stoops, squats, kneels, and crouches for durations up to 30 minutes
    • Works extended hours, which may include evenings, weekends, and holidays
    • Works safely near large, hot, high-speed machines

What Makes You Stand Out – Preferred

  • Completion of Tech school program
  • 5 or more years of experience working with Pipeline maintenance or operation, l&E, and mechanical pump experience
  • Knowledge of Allen Bradley Control/Compact Logic or Siemens Control systems
  • Knowledge of VFD drives
  • Trouble shooting electrical problems on 240, 480, and 4160v systems
  • Reading manufacturer specifications or blueprints to assemble or disassemble complex systems
  • Repairing and installing instrumentation and electrical equipment
  • Working Knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Word

Compensation Range

This position has a base salary range of $81,000 – $123,200.

At Phillips 66, we are committed to pay transparency and competitive, equitable compensation. Each role is assigned a salary grade with a defined pay range, benchmarked against industry peers. Where a candidate offer falls within the posted range depends on the candidate's experience, skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements. Offers are made to ensure internal equity and market competitiveness. Our compensation programs are designed to reward performance and support career growth.

Midstream

The Phillips 66 Midstream business is a safe, reliable, and trusted provider for the movement, storage, gathering, and processing of liquid or gas energy via pipelines or terminals. We are an industry leader in logistics and operate or manage more than 70,000 miles of pipelines that transport crude oil from oil fields to refineries and finished products from refineries to storage terminals. We operate 39 terminals that supply finished products to consumer gas stations, as well as crude oil and NGL storage terminals and NGL fractionation facilities. Our capabilities include extensive natural gas gathering and processing operations, enhancing our wellhead-to-market strategy. We also provide the connectivity between the various Phillips 66 business units.

Total Rewards

At Phillips 66, providing access to high quality programs and care for you and your family is important to us. Maintaining a culture of well-being — physical, emotional, social, and financial — is essential for a high-performing organization. When we are at our best, we are poised to deliver exceptional results — personally and professionally. Benefits for certain eligible, full-time employees include:

  • Annual Variable Cash Incentive Program (VCIP) bonus
  • 8% 401k company match
  • Cash Balance Account pension
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits with an annual company contribution to a Health Savings Account for employees on HDHP
  • Total well-being programs and incentives, including Employee Assistance Plan, well-being reimbursement, and backup family care services

Learn more about Phillips 66 Total Rewards.

Phillips 66 has more than 140 years of experience in providing the energy that enables people to dream bigger and go farther, faster. We are committed to improving lives, and that is our promise to our employees and our communities. We are sustained by the backgrounds and experiences of our diverse teams, which reflect who we are, the environment we create and how we work together. We have been recognized by the Human Rights Campaign, U.S. Department of Labor and the Military Times for our continued commitment to inclusive practices and policies in the hiring and retention of those in the LGBTQ+ community and military veterans. Our company is built on values of safety, honor and commitment. We call our cultural mindset Our Energy in Action, which we define through four simple, intuitive behaviors: We work for the greater good, cultivate an environment of trust, seek different perspectives and pursue excellence.

Learn more about Phillips 66 and how we are working to meet the world's energy needs today and tomorrow, by visiting phillips66.com.

title: Production/Commissioning and Start-Up Engineer
description:
Ensuring Chart’s Success…

“Cooler By Design” – Chart’s core business is centered around the design and fabrication of cryogenic equipment; so you can see where we get our tagline from, right? Well, yes and no – see, we think the products we design and build are pretty cool too. Also, we’re problem solvers. Customers don’t come to Chart with an equipment specification, they come to Chart with a challenge. That’s where you come in, because someone has to figure it out – all the way from conceptual design to installation and commissioning of equipment on-site. Chart’s mission is to provide full solutions across the Nexus of Clean™ – clean power, clean water, clean food, and clean industrials. The diverse applications we service echo our commitment to sustainability – from providing full hydrogen solutions across the value chain, offering small and industrial scale carbon capture solutions to customers globally, creating water treatment systems responsible for treating 4.5 billion gallons of water per day in the U.S. and delivering clean water to over a billion people worldwide, providing equipment and solutions for mission critical space launches, decarbonizing the marine industry, and electrifying the mining space. Chart even contributes to the food and beverage industry by making some of your favorite carbonated beverages possible – If nitro coffee or nitro ice cream is your thing – well, that’s Chart technology too (and it’s also cool)!

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Production/Commissioning and Start-Up Engineer to join our team at our Orem, UT location, developing the Cryogenic Carbon Capture process. This role will be pivotal in ensuring the successful on-site operation of our innovative technologies and leading operational teams to achieve optimal performance. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem-solver, comfortable taking ownership of operational challenges and will drive efficient solutions in a fast-paced environment. This is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of cutting-edge technology deployment and will contribute directly to our success.

What Will You Do?

  • Provide on-site leadership and technical guidance for the commissioning, start-up, and ongoing operation of Chart's process technologies at customer locations.
  • Lead and mentor on-site operations teams, ensuring adherence to safety protocols, operational procedures, and performance targets.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for operational matters at project sites, fostering strong communication and collaboration with customers and internal teams.
  • Troubleshoot operational issues, identify root causes, and implement effective corrective and preventative actions.
  • Implement and help develop best practices for on-site operations, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), maintenance schedules, and performance monitoring systems.
  • Conduct performance analysis of operations operating systems, identify areas for improvement, and drive initiatives to enhance efficiency and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and project management teams to ensure smooth project execution and successful handover to operations.
  • Participate in the development and review of operational documentation, including start-up manuals and operating procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant safety and environmental regulations at project sites.
  • Extensive Travel: Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% of the time to various customer sites for on-site operational support and leadership.

Your Physical Work Environment Will Require…

The employee frequently is required to sit for extended periods of time, stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to sit, climb, balance, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Lifting 50 pounds may be required. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Duties include lengthy visual requirements on computer monitors. Frequent travel will involve time spent in transit and at customer sites, which may have varying environmental conditions.

Your Experience Should Be...

  • A technical or engineering degree or equivalent practical experience in a relevant field (e.g., operations management, industrial technology, applied science).
  • Proven experience in leading and managing operational teams in industrial or technical environments.
  • Strong understanding of process operations, preferably within the energy, industrial gas, or related sectors.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex operational issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills, with the ability to effectively interact with diverse teams and customers.
  • Sound organizational skills for managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines.
  • Experience with the development and implementation of standard operating procedures and best practices.
  • Experience with cryogenic process technologies, natural gas processing, or similar complex industrial systems, preferred.
  • Familiarity with process control systems and instrumentation is a plus.
  • Experience in commissioning and start-up of industrial facilities.
  • Knowledge of safety regulations and best practices in industrial environments.

Our Benefits Package...

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Employer contributions to an HSA account
  • Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Company-paid short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • Basic life insurance with the option to purchase supplemental individual, spouse and dependent child coverage
  • Up to two weeks of paid family leave
  • 401k retirement savings plan including a company match

title: Managing Director, Head of US GPS
description:
In compliance with applicable laws, HSBC is committed to employing only those who are authorized to work in the US. HSBC may engage in immigration sponsorship for this position if needed.

Our purpose – Opening up a world of opportunity – explains why we exist. Here at HSBC, we use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth, and perspectives to open up new kinds of opportunity for our more than 40 million customers. We’re bringing together the people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world – for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities, and the planet we all share.

Global Payments Solutions (GPS) is a core transaction banking business within Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB), enabling clients to move money, manage cash flow and optimize liquidity through an integrated suite of payment, liquidity, receivables and card solutions.

GPS is a leading global payments provider, voted by clients as #1 Global Cash Management provider in the EuroMoney survey 2026 and ranked #2 by market share. GPS’ International, Innovative and Insightful solutions are deeply embedded into client’s operating environment, making it the most frequent touch point for them. The market position reflects the trust clients place every day into the world class team that makes GPS.

Reporting to the Global Head of GPS, the Head of US GPS leads the US business, with accountability for strategy, financial performance, competitive positioning, client outcomes, organisational capability and a robust risk and control environment.

As a member of the GPS Global Leadership Team, the role holder represents the US GPS business in global and US forums, helps shape the global GPS agenda through US client insights, market opportunities and strategic priorities, and ensures that US priorities are reflected in the wider business agenda.

The role is accountable for:

Business impact and financial performance

  • Own US GPS Profit & Loss (P&L) performance and financial planning, setting priorities for revenue growth, Profit Before Tax (PBT), cost discipline and investment, and allocating resources to deliver sustainable returns and Financial Resource Planning (FRP) targets within agreed risk appetite and delegated authority
  • Define and deliver the US GPS strategy, aligned with global priorities, and help shape the global GPS agenda through US client insights, market opportunities and strategic priorities. Ensure an optimal balance of Net Fee Income (NFI) and Net Interest Income (NII), proactively manage costs, and achieve and exceed key performance indicators while building a sustainable business model
  • Lead US-originated and inbound cross-border GPS growth, mobilising HSBC’s international network to deepen client relationships and capture opportunities across payments, liquidity and cash management
  • Drive the delivery of a comprehensive and competitive suite of Global Payments Solutions through a range of delivery channels by executing a commercially focused product management strategy that aligns with customer requirements
  • Lead the development and execution of a high-quality client-centric service culture that delivers superior post-sales support to CIB clients across the range of GPS products in the US
  • Strengthen HSBC’s competitive position in priority US client segments through differentiated propositions, increased client penetration and market share, and superior client outcomes, with external recognition providing supporting evidence of progress
  • Set US GPS operating budgets and performance scorecards, holding the leadership team accountable for delivery and ensuring strategic alignment with global and CIB US imperatives
  • Take responsibility for running a GPS business that complies with global and US regulatory requirements, ensure fair outcomes for customers and minimize reputational risk for GPS
  • Direct the allocation of US GPS resources across people, premises and systems, using decision-focused Management Information (MI) to assess performance, capacity and investment trade-offs

Customers / Stakeholders

  • Be accountable for delivering a world-class customer experience by cultivating a consistent selling and relationship management culture
  • Act as executive sponsor for strategic client relationships and material new-business opportunities, engaging with CFOs and senior treasury leaders to deepen partnerships and deliver commercially disciplined growth
  • Establish metrics and ensure effective tracking of competitors’ offerings and performance against HSBC’s
  • Deepen customer relationships by championing business collaboration with key stakeholders, including CIB, Global Trade Solutions (GTS), and Markets & Securities Services (MSS), and ensure strong network with key external stakeholders, such as regulatory bodies and fintech vendors
  • Understand current economic trends and their impact on HSBC in the US. Identify key levers to capitalise on opportunities or minimise downside exposure
  • Partner with US CIB leadership and global GPS peers to shape business priorities, resolve cross-business trade-offs and mobilise collective resources to deliver GPS and wider CIB objectives, representing GPS at US governance committees and forums

Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing US GPS leadership team, with clear accountability, empowered decision-making and strong succession depth; develop the organisational capabilities and culture required to deliver the business strategy, fostering care, employee engagement and motivation
  • Lead the HSBC conduct and culture agenda across the US, ensuring that the fair treatment of customers is at the heart of everything we do, both personally and as an organisation
  • Establish clear authority in risk-related matters at relevant management meetings
  • Lead across functional boundaries and provide clear guidance to teams when required
  • Set and sponsor the US GPS transformation agenda, working with GPS Sub Value Stream Heads and Technology and Operations partners to prioritise investment, strengthen digital capabilities, simplify the operating model and deliver measurable commercial and client benefits, in line with the GPS front-to-back Value Stream operating model
  • Mobilise US teams and businesses around shared priorities, strengthening collaboration and scaling best practices across organisational boundaries
  • Set the US GPS talent and capability agenda, aligning development and recognition with strategic priorities and creating an environment where individual and team contributions are encouraged and rewarded
  • Own succession planning for key leadership roles, building a strong pipeline of talent and development opportunities to support business continuity and future growth
  • Shape the US GPS organisation and workforce plan within agreed headcount, ensuring the leadership capacity, skills and resources required to meet business demands and capture strategic opportunities
  • Live the HSBC values and Leadership principles. Cultivate and promote an environment that supports diversity and inclusion, upholds HSBC’s values and reflects the HSBC brand

Risk, controls and operational effectiveness

  • Own first-line risk management and the control environment for US GPS, ensuring the business operates within agreed risk appetite, maintains effective oversight of operational resilience and material change, and delivers timely remediation of control weaknesses in partnership with relevant Risk Stewards
  • Maintain and observe all HSBC control standards and implement and observe the Group Risk & Compliance Policies and adherence to internal controls i.e. all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, as applicable, timely resolution of self / audit identified issues, including issues raised by external regulators. Foster a strong conduct and compliance culture
  • Implement Group Risk & Compliance Policies locally by managing risk in liaison with Risk Stewards, including Financial Crime, Regulatory Compliance and Enterprise Risk Management
  • Continually reassess the business risks inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings and the impact of new technology
  • Contribute to the overall corporate governance structure in the US, including policy and decision-making, as a member of various committees
  • Be accountable for robust oversight of strategic business opportunities, change programmes and the management of spend

Knowledge & Experience

  • Substantial and broad banking experience, transaction banking, corporate banking and customer relationship management, including an in-depth knowledge of commercial payments business on a global basis
  • Proven and progressive product management, business development, and P&L management experience, including extensive experience in the operational side of international banking
  • Superior knowledge of treasury management concepts with previous experience of working in corporate banking, or the treasury areas of a bank or corporate
  • Demonstrated success leading a substantial payments or transaction banking business, with P&L accountability and a track record of profitable growth, strategic transformation, leadership-team development and effective risk management in a complex international matrix
  • Executive-level communication and influencing skills, with credibility with senior corporate clients and executive governance stakeholders, and the ability to align diverse interests and deliver outcomes in a complex international organisational structure
  • Proven ability to allocate resources and prioritise investment across a substantial business, balancing growth, profitability, organisational capability and risk within delegated authority
  • Sound executive judgement in resolving complex business issues and strategic trade-offs, with a track record of delivering financial, transformation and client outcomes within agreed budgets, timescales and quality standards
  • Working knowledge and a keen understanding of end-to-end bank operations, payment systems and information technology systems
  • Awareness of economic and political factors on a global basis and their impact on the Group and GPS business. Ability to predict trends and apply insights to the business where possible

As an HSBC employee, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities to ensure you have the right skills for today and tomorrow. We offer a competitive pay and benefits package including a robust Wellness Hub, all in a welcoming and inclusive work environment. You will be empowered to drive HSBC’s engagement with the communities we serve through an industry-leading volunteerism policy, a generous matching gift program, and a comprehensive program of immersive Sustainability and Climate Change Initiatives. You’ll want to join our Employee Resource Groups as they play a central part in life at HSBC, including the development of our employees and networking inside and outside of HSBC. We value difference. We succeed together. We take responsibility. We get it done. And we want you to help us build the bank of the future!

Your final fixed pay offer will depend on the candidate and several variables, including but not limited to, role responsibilities, skill set, depth of experience and education, licensing/certification requirements, internal relativity, and specific work location.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, race, national origin, ethnicity, disability or medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran service, religion, creed, sex, gender, pregnancy, childbirth, caregiver status, marital status, citizenship or immigration status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression or any other trait protected by applicable law.

title: Corporate Finance - Valuation & Financial Modelling Intern - Milan
description:
Pirola Corporate Finance S.p.A., a strategic financial advisory firm specialising in providing consultancy services for corporate finance transactions, is seeking undergraduates and recent graduates for an internship at its Milan office.

Role and activities

The successful candidates, who will join the Valuation & Financial Modelling team and be mentored by more experienced colleagues, will support the team in drafting business and financial plans and carrying out quantitative valuations of companies, business units and intangible assets (e.g. trademarks, customer lists, patents, know-how).

  • Analysis of the target company’s business model
  • Analysis of the target market for the subject of the valuation
  • Preliminary analyses to support the application of valuation methods commonly used for companies, business units and intangible assets
  • Identification of comparable companies to those being valued
  • Extraction of input data for the discount rate to be applied in the valuation analysis
  • Calculation and analysis of market and transaction multiples.

  • The role includes additional benefits such as meal vouchers and a wellbeing plan

  • Excellent IT skills (Microsoft Office suite)

The ideal candidate will also possess a strong ability to work as part of a team, as well as excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

title: Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) Officer
description:
Company Overview

Action Against Hunger is an international humanitarian organization committed to ending world hunger. For almost 45 years, across countries, we have been working to fight undernutrition and support communities affected by crisis across the globe.

We carry out innovative, lifesaving programs in Health, Nutrition, Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH), Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS), Food Security and Livelihoods (FSL) and Social Protection.

Action Against Hunger Nigeria (ACF Nigeria) LTD/GTE began operations in Nigeria in 2010 in response to the high rate of chronic malnutrition in Northern Nigeria, focusing on integrated programming. Action Against Hunger currently implements multi-sectoral humanitarian and development interventions in Northeast and Northwest Nigeria, funded by AFD, EU/ECHO, French Government, GAC, GFFO, SIDA, US Government, and WAM Foundation.

Action Against Hunger is currently looking to fill the role of MEAL Officer Ensure implementation of the MEAL plan for the FSL, Health and Nutrition and WASH programmes including monitoring progress against planned activities, critical milestones and targets as well as providing support and guidance to program officers and CSO/government counterparts to ensure that the data collection, data management and reporting, are of the highest possible quality.

Position Details

Reporting to: MEAL Manager
Proposed start date: November 2026
Work location: Nguru, Yobe State

Key Responsibilities:

Objective 1: Coordinate Data Collection, Data Quality Management, Analysis and State Level Reporting

  • Participate in the design of programme Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning tools (registers, reporting templates, data bases, etc.) to track FSL, Health and Nutrition, and WASH sectors/projects.
  • In collaboration with various sector stakeholders and relevant ACF staff, ensure timely data collection, compilation, and reporting according to the programme MEAL plan.
  • Conduct monthly data analysis and prepare monthly programme monitoring reports.
  • Ensure the programme database is updated regularly.
  • Support programme feedback meetings to communities, facilities, and authorities.
  • Support the MEAL Manager to implement the DQA system, including the conduct of data quality assessments according to the MEAL plan.
  • Support the MEAL Manager in data management for assessments, analysis, surveys, evaluations, and other research as required.
  • Plan, forecast, and facilitate the production and supply of MEAL tools and materials to supported sites.

Objective 2: Support Programme Supervision, Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning
  • Support the MEAL Manager to monitor FSL, Health and Nutrition, and WASH sectors/projects across all target communities and communicate findings and progress to Program Managers.
  • Participate in the evaluation of FSL, Health and Nutrition, and WASH sectors/projects, focusing on data management of evaluation datasets.
  • Support the dissemination and use of evaluation and research reports and propose changes for improvement to the FSL, Health and Nutrition and WASH sectors/projects Team.

Objective 3: Support Documentation, Reporting, Knowledge Sharing and Effective Feedback Mechanism
  • Support coordination of FSL, Health and Nutrition, and WASH sectors/projects monthly, quarterly, biannual and annual reviews and reports as required.
  • Participate in the dissemination of program information to communities, beneficiaries, and other stakeholders through a regular feedback mechanism.
  • Support the management of the beneficiary complaints and feedback mechanism database.
  • Update shared drive and project team space with program monitoring documents regularly.

Position Requirements:
  • Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Rural Development, Business, Administration, statistics, demography, or related subject, with previous experience working in humanitarian projects.
  • 2-3 years of previous experience with local or international NGOs.
  • Previous experience with FSL, WASH, and Health and Nutrition projects.
  • Proficiency in the use of MS Excel or other statistical packages. E.g SPSS, STATA, ODK.
  • Fluency in English, Hausa, and Kanuri.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including report writing.
  • Ability to work effectively with teams, government institutions, and development partners.
  • Demonstrated independence, adaptability, and flexibility in dynamic work environments.
At Action Against Hunger, we foster a work culture that champions diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are committed to creating an environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive

title: Postdoctoral Researcher: Predicting brain stimulation through network dynamics
description:
Welcome to Maastricht University!
Do you want to contribute to innovative research in computational neuroscience and neural engineering? Are you passionate about understanding how brain networks respond to stimulation, and how to predict and control that response? Then we would like to meet you.

Postdoctoral Researcher: predicting brain stimulation through network dynamics

Our goal: Brain stimulation is increasingly used to enhance cognition and to treat neurological disorders, but its success depends on choosing the right target and the right moment. In this project you will develop a computational framework that predicts how an individual’s brain network responds to an intervention, by combining latent brain-state models, effective connectivity estimated with dynamic causal modelling (DCM), and network control theory. The framework will be evaluated in two settings: EEG combined with transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) during a memory task, and stereo-EEG (SEEG) in patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, where it aims to guide target selection for radiofrequency thermocoagulation (RFTC).

Your colleagues: You will be embedded in two research groups at Maastricht University and work closely with both. The group of Dr. Ryszard Auksztulewicz (Department of Neuropsychology and Psychopharmacology, Faculty of Psychology and Neuroscience) studies cognition with biophysically realistic models of effective connectivity. The group of Dr. Borbála Hunyadi (Department of Neurosurgery, Faculty of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences) is a team of engineers developing signal processing methods for clinical neurophysiology, with a focus on network biomarkers and epilepsy. You will also collaborate with our colleagues providing data, including Dr. Tuba Aktürk (Department of Cognitive Neuroscience, FPN) and Dr. Simon Tousseyn (Kempenhaeghe / MUMC+ / Brain&Nerve Center).

You will work in a challenging academic position within a dynamic and multidisciplinary research team. Together with your colleagues you will have the opportunity to play a role in innovation in research in neuropsychology. On top of that you will work in an inspiring working environment at Maastricht University, where education and research are closely connected to societal impact.

What you do

As a postdoctoral researcher, you will develop and validate this framework, from theory to application. You will design methods that combine latent-state estimation, dynamic causal modelling and network control theory, and test them in simulations with known ground truth. You will then apply the framework to existing datasets: EEG–tACS recordings during a memory task, and SEEG recordings from 30 patients with epilepsy treated with RFTC, predicting when stimulation is most effective for memory and which RFTC targets lead to seizure freedom.

You will publish in high-quality peer-reviewed journals, present your work at international conferences, release the framework as open-source code and contribute to follow-up grant applications. You will work across both groups, collaborate with clinicians and neuroscientists, and help supervise MSc students working on related projects.

Are you ready to set the course for the years ahead? Then we’d love to meet you.

What you bring

  • A PhD in computational neuroscience or biomedical engineering, or a related field
  • Excellent programming skills (e.g. Python or MATLAB) and experience writing reproducible, well-documented code
  • Experience with the analysis or modelling of neural time series, such as EEG, SEEG or MEG
  • Experience with dynamic causal modelling, network control theory or whole-brain modelling is a plus
  • Strong mathematical skills, in particular in linear algebra, dynamical systems and statistics; knowledge of control theory, state-space models or estimation theory is a strong plus
  • A genuine interest in cognitive neuroscience and clinical applications
  • A track record of peer-reviewed publications appropriate to career stage
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a multidisciplinary team spanning two research groups
  • Strong communication skills and proficiency in English

What we offer
At Maastricht University, you’ll work in an international, open, and engaged environment. We offer:

  • A 24-month contract (1,0 fte).
  • A gross monthly salary between €3706,00 and €5760,00 (based on full-time employment of 38 hours per week). 8% holiday allowance and an 8.3% year-end bonus.
  • 29 vacation days (based on full-time), four additional days off (Carnival Monday and Tuesday, Good Friday, and Liberation Day), and the possibility to accrue up to 12 extra days through compensation hours.
  • Flexible working hours, a home office allowance, and the option to work from home.
  • Freedom and space to shape your work independently and develop your ideas.
  • A close-knit community of colleagues to collaborate and grow with.
  • A solid pension plan via ABP, company fitness schemes, and access to various university sports facilities.
  • An inspiring work environment in the heart of Europe.


About the Faculty of Psychology and Neuroscience (FPN)
At FPN, we share a curiosity about the human brain and behaviour. Together with our students, we explore how our brains function and learn why we do what we do. We connect perspectives and contribute to living together in society.


Interested?
Want to know more about this position or what it’s like to work at our university? Reach out to Ryszard Auksztulewicz at ryszard.auksztulewicz@maastrichtuniversity.nl or Borbála Hunyadi at borbala.hunyadi@maastrichtuniversity.nl. The end date of the publication is 27 November 2026. Interviews likely take place mid December.

Apply now via the button below. We look forward to getting to know you!


About Maastricht University
At Maastricht University, we collaboratively seek solutions to help move the world forward. We do this with 23,300 students and 5,400 employees across 5 regional locations, 6 faculties, and more than 70 research institutes. We encourage you to push boundaries and discover new opportunities for yourself and the world around you. Together, we can find the answers for tomorrow.

The vacancy is open for internal and external candidates. In case of equal qualifications, internal candidates will be prioritized.

At Maastricht University, we prefer to contact potential candidates directly. We therefore kindly ask that no agencies or intermediaries submit offers or approaches.

Maastricht University is committed to promoting and nurturing a diverse and inclusive community. We believe that diversity in our staff and student population contributes to the quality of research and education at UM, and strive to enable this through inclusive policies and innovative projects led by teams of staff and students. title: Cleared R&D Systems Engineer - Interconnectivity and Verification, Onsite
description:
About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

  • Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
  • Extraordinary co-workers
  • Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
  • Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
  • Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov


*These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like

We are seeking an R&D Systems Engineer to support our dynamic group in the Mobile Guardian Transport Program Management and System Engineering group.

On any given day, you may be called on to:

  • Use systems engineering principles to implement multidisciplinary engineering approaches to research, design, or develop structures, experiments, processes, systems, theories, or technologies; to construct or operate the same with full cognizance of their design or to forecast their behavior.
  • Initiate, design, develop, execute, and evaluate new processes, products, or systems through basic and applied systems engineering research.
  • Utilize creativity and critical thinking in Systems Engineering principles to proactively discern, identify, troubleshoot and mitigate requirements, design, and manufacturing challenges to ensure successful product realization in partnership with a variety of subsystem teams and sponsor needs.
  • Support preparation of all detailed system documentation, to include failure mode analysis, system behaviors, interface control documents, system design specifications, requirement verification reports, etc.
  • Support the analysis and interpretation of test data and recommend alternative solutions to problems and obstacles.
  • Work on a specific task basis to support or lead technical activities across multiple disciplines including electrical engineering, systems engineering, mechanical engineering, software engineering, and security.

Due to nature of this work the selected applicant must be able to work onsite.

Salary Range

$102,400 - $199,700

*Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development.
  • Active DOE Q clearance or equivalent

Qualifications We Desire

The ideal R&D S&E Systems Engineering candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:

  • Graduate degree in Engineering or a highly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation).
  • Experience working with Nuclear Security Enterprise (NSE) laboratories and plants including Pantex, Kansas City National Security Campus (KCNSC), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL), Los Alamos National Laboratory, and Kansas City National Security Campus/New Mexico Operations (KCNSC/NMO).
  • Experience working on engineering design, qualification, production, or related modeling/simulation projects.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams.

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:

  • Demonstrated ability to conceptualize, understand, execute on, and communicate major elements of design, engineering, maintenance, processes, or policies.
  • Ability and confidence working in a classified environment and with classified components
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Ability to model behaviors that reflect Sandia's core values
  • Experience with:
    • Design Agency/ Production Agency partnerships
    • Working in a schedule, budget, or requirement constrained environment
    • Complex electrical, mechanical, software, and/or integrated system designs development, prototype, and test
    • Defining technical requirements, validating execution of requirements, planning, designing, integrating, implementing, and testing engineering solutions
    • Modified commercial of the shelf parts and definition
    • System and subsystem description documents
    • Documentation, design processes, and requirements including release in EIMS or PRIME
    • Ability to emphasize small details and orders of operations by breaking down systems into manageable and discrete parts for better understanding and troubleshooting.
    • Awareness of engineering principles and basic technical responsibilities, including design and systems technology, within a designated subject area

About Our Team

Mobile Guardian Transport Program Management and System Engineering (SE) department is responsible for the overall system design, requirement adherence, and performance of the next generation safe and secure transportation system. This system includes electrical, mechanical, and security components in a complex architecture with custom embedded software and requiring a diverse, technical SE team. In addition, we provide program leadership and coordination to the MGT program team.

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Security Clearance

Position requires a Department of Energy (DOE) Q security clearance to start, or equivalent active security clearance with another U.S. government agency (e.g., DOD). Sandia is required by DOE directive to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

EEO

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

NNSA Requirements for MedPEDs

If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

title: Mechanical Maintenance Planner/Scheduler Professional II/Lead
description:
Joining the Metallus team means becoming part of a legacy that dates back over a century. We are an industry leader, manufacturing the cleanest steel in the world for companies in the industrial, aerospace and defense, automotive, and energy markets.

Relocation will not be offered for this role.

Purpose

Steel manufacturing demands substantial asset investment, with annual maintenance costs exceeding one hundred million dollars. This role is key to lowering those costs and ensuring efficient use of our maintenance and contractor resources.

The role of the Planner/Scheduler is to improve workforce effectiveness and work quality by anticipating and eliminating potential delays through proactive planning and coordination of manpower, parts and materials, and equipment access. The position is responsible for planning future work; ensuring Manufacturing has a sufficient backlog of tasks that are fully planned, approved, and ready for execution; using personal experience and closed backlog to develop work plans that avoid potential delays and quality or safety issues; and scheduling work by loading labor hours and providing the workforce with sufficient assignments for their shifts.

Responsibilities

1. Job Plan Development

    • Defines required materials, spare parts, special tools, and equipment necessary to execute work efficiently.
    • Estimates labor hours and craft requirements using planning standards and experience.
    • Builds task level job plans that clearly define work steps, safety considerations, quality requirements, and execution sequence.
    • Assembles complete work packages including job plans, permits, drawings, lockout requirements, special instructions, and supporting documentation.
    • Identifies and drives revisions to PMs, job plans, BOMs, and work instructions to improve future execution.

2. Scheduling

    • Supports scheduling functions by loading and leveling planned work to available labor capacity.
    • Schedules daily and weekly work in the scheduling tool for assigned areas of responsibility.
    • Maintains outage and shutdown calendars; supports long range planning for major work and outages.
    • Leads pre outage planning meetings and conducts post outage reviews ( AAR/6-Pack)to capture lessons learned and improve planning accuracy.

3. Work Planning and Backlog Management

    • Converts approved service requests into fully planned work orders, ensuring correct asset hierarchy, failure codes, and cost charging in Maximo.
    • Maintains a ready to work backlog, ensuring jobs are planned to a standard that supports safe, efficient execution without delays.
    • Performs field walk downs to analyze job requirements, validate scope, and identify safety, access, tooling, and sequencing needs.
    • Develops detailed job plans using BOMs, engineering drawings, historical data, and best practices.

4. Collaboration and Continuous Improvements

    • Works closely with Maintenance, Operations, Engineering, Reliability, and SMEs to resolve issues related to spare parts, BOM accuracy, asset data, and work procedures.
    • Submits drawing updates and documentation changes to Engineering as required.
    • Supports plant KPIs including EHS, quality, productivity, schedule compliance, backlog health, and continuous improvement initiatives.
    • Performs monthly LPA audits and supports Reliability Excellence standards.
    • Additional responsibilities are defined in the Reliability Excellence RACI documents.
    • Coordinate predictive maintenance scheduling, compliance, driving corrective actions to mitigate equipment risk and unplanned failures and increase reliability.
    • Submits purchase requests for materials and services to perform planned work.

Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with industrial maintenance and exposure to work planning and order prioritization techniques.
  • Ability to read and understand engineered drawings.
  • Trained on industrial systems: hydraulics, pneumatics, PLC, motor drives, power distribution.
  • Solid understanding of equipment assemblies, systems engineering, and maintenance best practices.
  • Prior knowledge of Maximo or CMMS.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office.
  • Functional knowledge on equipment assemblies and systems engineering.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma/GED with a minimum 7 years of craftsmanship or supervisor experience in planning and scheduling work or experience with CMMS systems for work orders.
  • Associate's degree in mechanical engineering, technology, or related degree with a minimum 4 years of craftsmanship or supervisor experience in planning and scheduling work or experience with CMMS systems for work orders.
  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, technology, or related degree with a minimum 2 years of craftsmanship or supervisor experience in planning and scheduling work or experience with CMMS systems for work orders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • High School Diploma/GED with a minimum 12 years of craftsmanship or supervisor experience in planning and scheduling work or experience with CMMS systems for work orders.
  • Associate's degree in mechanical engineering, technology, or related degree with a minimum 9 years of craftsmanship or supervisor experience in planning and scheduling work or experience with CMMS systems for work orders.
  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, technology, or related degree with a minimum 7 years of craftsmanship or supervisor experience in planning and scheduling work or experience with CMMS systems for work orders.

title: Letter Carrier - Delivery Agent
description:
Job Requisition Id: 205350
Business Function: Delivery Agent or Letter Carrier
Primary City: Timmins
Other Location(s):
Province: Ontario
Employment Type: Temporary - New
Employment Status: Temporary
Language Requirement: English or French Essential (Either/OR)
Number of Vacancies 5
Salary: $25.37

Job Description

Canada Post is an exciting place to work! And you can be part of it!

We deliver billions of items to Canadians each year – and you can be a big part of making this happen. As a temporary, on-call delivery agent (also known as a letter carrier), you’ll be the face of Canada Post in your community and make sure customers and businesses get the mail and parcels they’re waiting for.

Does this sound like you? The role of delivery agent would be a great fit if you:

  • enjoy being outside and active year-round
  • want to work for a great national company
  • would be proud to serve your fellow Canadians

Job Responsibilities

What will you do?

  • You’ll start your day in the depot, sorting and preparing the day’s deliveries
  • You’ll load and drive a Canada Post postal vehicle

Job Responsibilities (continued)

  • You’ll then spend most of your day outside, delivering mail and packages by foot or by vehicle to customers on your route
  • You’ll return to the depot to unload the day’s incoming mail and packages for later delivery

Qualifications

What must you have?

  • A valid Class 5 or Class G driver’s licence with a safe driving record for at least 3 years (driver's abstract required)
  • The physical ability to lift mail items weighing up to 22.7 kg (50 lb) and carry items weighing up to 15.9 kg (35 lb) regularly throughout the day
  • The ability to work in all types of weather
  • The availability to be on-call
  • The ability to read, write and speak English and/or French

These help, too!

  • Experience in customer service
  • Experience making deliveries or working as a driver

In return, we offer:

  • Competitive pay
  • Extensive classroom and on-the-job training about your duties and safety on the job
  • Opportunities for permanent employment

Other Information

Today’s Canada Post - Canada Post is an e-commerce powerhouse, delivering billions of items every year. We help small businesses grow. We enrich lives in remote communities. We connect Canadians with each other and to the rest of the world. And we do all this by providing residential and business customers with the best possible delivery experience in the country.

We like to promote from within and can offer you a career rather than a job. While, like all of our delivery agents, you’ll start out on a temporary, on-call basis, you’ll have the opportunity to grow with us and obtain a permanent position … even try out new jobs in different areas of the company.

Canada Post’s values and behaviours

Our Values - Trust, Respect and Deliver represent our fundamental promise to ourselves, our expectations of one and another and our shared duty to our country.

Our behaviours – Make the call, Know the destination, Deliver for others, Ignite our pride; embody our values, bringing them to life and guiding our actions.

We’re committed to living these values and practicing these behaviours every day. Learn more about the values and behaviours by visiting the Canada Post website.

title: Master Data Management Specialist
description:
Our KPMG Lighthouse is growing!

Do you enjoy bringing structure to data and helping organisations trust the information they run their business on? Do you have a background in data management and see Master Data Management (MDM) as the foundation of every successful data transformation? Then we would love to meet you.

KPMG Lighthouse, the Belgian Center of Excellence for Data & AI, is looking for a Master Data Management Specialist / Consultant. You will join challenging data transformations across a wide range of industries and help clients turn their master data into a reliable business asset.

About the team

As MDM specialist you become part of KPMG Lighthouse, our data and AI center of excellence. We help clients across industries turn data into value, from data strategy, governance and master data management to data engineering, analytics, AI and intelligent automation. Data management specialists, data engineers, data scientists and AI and automation experts work side by side, so we can support clients from solid data foundations all the way to AI at scale. We are a close-knit, energetic team that combines strategy with hands-on delivery, and we like to have fun while doing it.

What you will do

  • Contribute to MDM projects from assessment and design to implementation and adoption, and take ownership of workstreams as you grow.

  • Help clients shape their MDM strategy, roadmap and business case.

  • Define and embed MDM principles at clients, such as data governance, roles and responsibilities, and data quality.

  • Analyse business processes and translate business needs into clear data requirements.

  • Translate MDM requirements into solution designs within complex system landscapes, working closely with data and solution architects.

  • Coach junior colleagues and help grow our MDM practice through proposals, offering development and knowledge sharing.

What you bring

If you have a solid data management background and a real interest in MDM, we want to hear from you!

Ideally:

  • You have a master's degree and around 4 to 6 years of experience in data management, for example in master data, data quality, data governance, data modelling or data architecture.

  • You have hands-on exposure to MDM, such as solving data quality, master data or data integration challenges, in a consulting role or within a business or IT team.

  • You have a high-level understanding of data architecture and how master data flows across systems.

  • You are analytical and pragmatic: you get to the root of a problem and turn it into a workable solution.

  • You explain data topics in plain language, feel at ease facilitating workshops and connect business and IT.

  • You build trust with clients and bring people along in change, knowing that MDM is as much about people and processes as about technology.

  • You are a true team player. You share your knowledge openly, ask for help when you need it and give and receive honest feedback. You enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams, you support your colleagues when the pressure is on, and you like celebrating successes together, both on client projects and within the Lighthouse community.

  • You have a self-starter mindset, curiosity about AI, technology and the drive to keep growing.

  • Fluency in English and Dutch or French.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a consultancy environment.

  • Hands-on experience with MDM, data quality or data governance tools (e.g. SAP MDG, Informatica, Stibo STEP, Collibra).

  • Knowledge of major ERP packages such as SAP or Dynamics 365 and their underlying data architecture.

  • Experience coaching or guiding more junior colleagues.

#LI-DNI

As a certified Top Employer we offer:

  • A reward package that goes beyond salary. Think premium electric company car + charging card, net allowances, bonus, a mobile phone with subscription, and lots of extras you can personalize with our cafeteria plan.
  • Peace of mind with full insurance coverage. We’ve got you covered with group and hospitalization insurance, plus optional extras like dental, eye care, and medical consultations.
  • Work in your own way. Enjoy flexible hours, hybrid working, and even the chance to work from anywhere in the world for 20 days a year.
  • We’re an international community that thrives on trust and collaboration. With inclusive communities for gender, LGBTQ+, internationals, and many more, you’ll truly feel like you can come as you are.
  • Your growth = our priority. You’ll get training and development tailored to your job, level and even personal goals, plus support from your personal buddy and performance manager.
  • More than colleagues. From sport challenges (Antwerp 10 Miles, Brussels Marathon, 1000km for KOTK) to volunteering (river clean-ups, tree planting), we make impact together through our Together@KPMG & KPMG Foundation programs.
  • We care about you. With initiatives such as confidential counselors, an employee assistance program, hotlines and more, we will support your emotional and mental health throughout your career.
  • Fun included. Expect team events, afterworks, and plenty of opportunities to connect outside the office, for those who want. Follow @KPMGBelgium on Instagram to find out what life at KPMG is really like.

The Vice-President, Research & Innovation (VPRI) portfolio supports the University of Toronto as a top public research university in the world. Our mission is to create the most supportive environment possibleso that our researchers, innovators and learners can do what they do best — advance understanding and apply new knowledge. Your opportunity:

Reporting to the Executive Director, Strategic Initiatives, this role will work across the university’s three campuses to support the development and growth of high-profile, large-scale, interdisciplinary, multi-unit research initiatives.

The Institutional Strategic Initiatives Officer is a key member of the Institutional Strategic Initiatives (ISI) team within the VPRI portfolio. The role contributes to ISI team operations and supports the advancement of large, multi-stakeholder research initiatives. A key focus of this position will be advancing the University's Defence and Sovereignty Network, supporting research collaborations, strategic partnerships and funding opportunities in defence, security, sovereignty and dual-use innovation.

This position is responsible for the development and implementation of strategic plans for each initiative, aimed at securing substantial external funding. Working collaboratively across the University and with internal and external partners, the Institutional Strategic Initiatives Officer will identify research funding opportunities, support the preparation of collaborative funding applications, draft and edit proposal materials, and develop strategies to foster partnerships.

  • Experience identifying, developing and executing strategies for research and development partnerships involving government and/or industry, including demonstrated success in securing funding or contracts for collaborative research programs in sectors relevant to defence, security, sovereignty or dual-use technologies.
  • Experience conducting strategic research, environmental scans and landscape analyses to identify emerging research and innovation priorities, funding opportunities and partnership prospects, particularly in areas related to defence, security, sovereignty and dual-use technologies; demonstrated ability to synthesize findings into strategic recommendations, reports and briefing materials.
  • Experience with performance evaluation and benchmarking of research initiatives or projects

  • Proven analytical and problem solving skills and highly attentive to detail
