title: Director of Laboratory - Job ID: 244575
description:
Director of Laboratory Services - North Shore Medical Center

Position Summary

The Director of Laboratory Services is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, regulatory compliance, quality assurance, financial performance, and clinical support of the hospital laboratory. This position oversees all laboratory operations, including Clinical Chemistry, Hematology, Blood Bank/Transfusion Services, Microbiology, Immunology, Molecular Diagnostics, Anatomic Pathology support services, and Point-of-Care Testing programs.
The Director ensures that laboratory services are delivered safely, efficiently, and in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and accrediting agency requirements while supporting the hospital's mission, patient care objectives, and organizational goals.

Reporting Relationship

Reports to: Chief Operating Officer (COO), Chief Clinical Officer, or Chief Executive Officer
Direct Reports:
  • Laboratory Managers
  • Laboratory Supervisors
  • Technical Specialists
  • Quality Coordinator
  • Phlebotomy Leadership
  • Administrative Support Staff

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Direct and oversee daily laboratory operations across all laboratory departments.
  • Ensure timely, accurate, and cost-effective testing services.
  • Monitor laboratory productivity, workflow, staffing, and turnaround times.
  • Develop and implement departmental goals and strategic initiatives.
  • Collaborate with physicians, nursing leadership, and hospital departments to improve patient care outcomes.
  • Lead laboratory service expansions, technology upgrades, and process improvement initiatives.

Regulatory Compliance and Accreditation

  • Ensure compliance with CLIA, CAP, Joint Commission, OSHA, CMS, HIPAA, and applicable state regulations.
  • Maintain laboratory readiness for inspections, surveys, and audits.
  • Develop and enforce laboratory policies, procedures, and quality management systems.
  • Implement corrective actions for regulatory deficiencies and quality concerns.

Quality Management

  • Establish and monitor quality assurance and quality control programs.
  • Analyze quality indicators and key performance metrics.
  • Lead investigations related to laboratory errors, incidents, and patient safety events.
  • Promote continuous quality improvement initiatives throughout laboratory operations.

Financial Management

  • Develop and manage the laboratory operating and capital budgets.
  • Monitor departmental expenses, labor costs, productivity metrics, and revenue performance.
  • Identify opportunities for cost containment and operational efficiencies.
  • Participate in contract negotiations and vendor management activities.

Personnel Management

  • Recruit, hire, train, develop, and retain laboratory personnel.
  • Conduct performance evaluations and competency assessments.
  • Ensure adequate staffing schedules and succession planning.
  • Foster employee engagement, accountability, and professional development.

Clinical and Technical Oversight

  • Collaborate with Medical Directors and Pathologists regarding laboratory practices and services.
  • Evaluate and implement new testing methodologies and technologies.
  • Ensure proper validation and verification of laboratory instruments and testing procedures.
  • Maintain adherence to evidence-based laboratory practices.

Point-of-Care Testing Oversight

  • Oversee the organization's Point-of-Care Testing (POCT) program.
  • Monitor compliance with testing standards and competency requirements.
  • Partner with nursing and clinical departments to ensure effective POCT management.

Strategic Planning

  • Participate in hospital strategic planning initiatives.
  • Support organizational growth and service line development.
  • Evaluate emerging laboratory technologies and industry trends.
  • Develop long-term operational plans aligned with organizational objectives.

Qualifications

Education

Required:
  • Bachelor's Degree in Medical Technology, Clinical Laboratory Science, Biology, Chemistry, or related field.
Preferred:
  • Master's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Public Health, Clinical Laboratory Science, or related healthcare discipline.

Experience

Required:
  • Minimum 7-10 years of progressive clinical laboratory experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of laboratory leadership or management experience.
Preferred:
  • Prior director-level experience in an acute-care hospital.
  • Multi-department laboratory management experience.
  • Experience managing laboratory accreditation surveys and regulatory inspections.

Certifications

Required:
  • ASCP (American Society for Clinical Pathology) certification or equivalent laboratory credential.
Preferred:
  • MLS(ASCP)
  • DLM(ASCP)
  • Lean Six Sigma Certification
  • Certified Laboratory Manager designation

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Comprehensive knowledge of clinical laboratory operations.
  • Strong understanding of CLIA, CAP, Joint Commission, OSHA, CMS, and HIPAA requirements.
  • Financial management and budgeting expertise.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Strategic planning and project management abilities.
  • Experience with Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) and Electronic Medical Records (EMR).
  • Data analysis and performance improvement experience.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to move throughout laboratory and hospital environments.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally.
  • Visual and manual dexterity sufficient to review reports, operate computer systems, and inspect laboratory operations.

Performance Indicators

  • Laboratory turnaround times
  • Patient safety and quality metrics
  • Regulatory compliance outcomes
  • Employee engagement and retention
  • Budget performance
  • Customer satisfaction scores
  • Accreditation survey results
  • Productivity and efficiency measures

The Admissions Systems & Program Coordinator is a guardian of admissions data and works to maintain data integrity of the Admissions CRM and centralized applications systems such as PTCAS and CASPA, in a collaborative, supportive, and data-focused environment.

The Admissions Systems & Program Coordinator also assists with executing the written communication plan, which includes performing mail merges, printing, and overseeing the distribution of admission correspondences. They help to monitor a shared email inbox to provide accurate and timely information to prospective students and families. This position also assists with supervising a team of student employees who assist with mail handling and processing.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, technically-minded problem-solver who has strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and track multiple tasks. Previous experience with Salesforce, centralized application systems, the Google Workspace and Microsoft Word is helpful, the ability to learn it is required.

This is a full-time, on-site position based on our Glenside campus with the opportunity to work from home one to two days a week once fully trained. Candidates must reside within commuting distance upon hire.

Location: Glenside

Essential Functions:

Management and Monitoring of Prospective Student Data (40%):

  • Process prospective student inquiries, applications and supporting credentials (transcripts, recommendations, etc.); This includes monitoring automated processes and executing manual procedures and data entry for credentials submitted in support of student applications.
  • Verify PT and PA applicant eligibility by assessing applications and supporting credentials against established minimum admission requirements.
  • Move prospective students through the funnel by recognizing when applications are ready for departmental review, notifying appropriate reviewers, and ensuring review is completed in a timely fashion.
  • Take initiative to monitor and maintain data quality, identifying discrepancies and implementing solutions to ensure the accuracy and reliability of our data.
  • Recommend and implement solutions to correct data integrity issues, including data cleansing, validation, and correction procedures.
  • Maintain comprehensive operational procedure documentation.

Program Support (20%):

  • Serve as the primary EMM liaison between the Physical Therapy and Physician Assistant graduate programs, including the Transitional DPT and Hybrid DPT programs.
  • Partner with program faculty and EMM leadership to monitor application activity, admissions progress, and enrollment trends; identify potential barriers to enrollment goals and coordinate appropriate recruitment and yield strategies.
  • Coordinate with the departments during PTCAS and CASPA application-cycle configuration in partnership with the Director of Admissions Systems and Programs.
  • Work with program faculty and administrative staff as well as the Director for Admissions Events, Campus Visits and the New Student Experience to plan and execute program specific events.
  • Provide admissions support for the Hybrid DPT program, collaborating with program faculty, EMM colleagues, and the University's online program management (OPM) partner, including participating in meetings and coordinating admissions-related processes and activities.
  • Provide admissions support for the Transitional DPT program, collaborating with program faculty and EMM colleagues to coordinate admissions-related processes and activities, including those related to international applicants and international admissions practices.

Execution of Admissions Communication Plan (20%):

  • Execute mail merges in Ninetex (a Salesforce CRM Add-on) and Microsoft Word for printing admission correspondences.
  • Oversee assembly, sending and distribution of postal mailings.
  • Monitor materials inventory.
  • Assists with monitoring a shared admissions email inbox.

Supervision (10%):

  • Assist with supervising a team of student employees including hiring, training and mentoring.
  • Develop weekly schedules and task assignments.
  • Monitor student work.
  • Maintain detailed task manual for student workers.

Admission Support (10%):

  • Provide support to admission staff related to the Admissions CRM, Salesforce.
  • Required attendance at Open Houses and prospective student events; occasional weekend hours required.
  • Collaborate to identify opportunities for efficiency and automation.
  • Serve on other University committees, task forces, and advisory boards, as requested.
  • Perform other job-related duties, as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education, experience, and skills required:

  • Associate Degree.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Mail Merges, and spreadsheets.
  • Demonstrated technical aptitude and willingness to learn new technologies and systems.
  • Strong organization skills.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to multitask.
  • Ability to work independently and as a part of a team.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience in higher education, admissions, enrollment management, or a related setting.
  • Experience with CRM or database systems, preferably Salesforce or experience with centralized application systems such as PTCAS, CASPA, or other Liaison CAS systems.
  • Familiarity with professional program and/or international admissions practices.
  • Experience working collaboratively with faculty or other organizational stakeholders.

Due to the volume of applications received, communication will generally be limited to candidates selected for additional consideration.
  • Application review will begin immediately. Posting will be removed from the website once we've established a sufficient talent pool for consideration.

title: Divisional Head of Corporates - Monterrey
description:
The Divisional Head of Corporate will lead the Corporate Banking business across a specific Region which includes specific states of Mexican Republic, with responsibility for the Business Banking Upper, International Middle Market, and States & Municipalities segments. The role will focus on delivering sustainable business growth, strengthening customer relationships, managing risk and resources effectively, and developing a high-performing team.

The role holder will ensure the delivery of superior customer experience through well-trained colleagues, competitive products and services, and effective collaboration with product specialists and other HSBC business lines.

The role holder will also design and implement a commercial strategy focused on priority customers in Mexico, maximizing value for Mexico and the Group while supporting the objectives of the strategic plan. The role will ensure that the portfolio remains internationally focused and that effective collaboration is maintained across regions and customer segments.

Governance and Committee Memberships

IMM & BB Country ExCo meetings: Risk Management Meetings, Financial Crime Risk Management Meeting, ExCo offsites, other IMM % BB specific senior steering committees and ExCo.

Principal Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation and execution of the strategy across the West Region.
  • Deliver annual operating plan objectives and key performance indicators, including:
    • Revenue, expenses and profit before tax
    • Asset and liability balances and Returns
    • Business growth and customer outcomes
  • Build and maintain a sustainable business model aligned with the strategic plan.
  • Allocate resources effectively to support current performance and long-term growth.
  • Develop customer account plans, relationship strategies and pipeline management processes.
  • Deepen customer relationships and maximise share of wallet through collaboration across products and segments.
  • Ensure the effective use of the country balance sheet.
  • Monitor risk-weighted assets, impairment charges and early loss indicators.
  • Apply appropriate risk management tools and ensure that pricing reflects risk.
  • Monitor sales activity and key productivity metrics to ensure that performance meets or exceeds market standards.
  • Maintain compliance with all HSBC control and compliance standards.
  • Foster a strong compliance culture across the region.
  • Manage compliance risk in partnership with the relevant Compliance functions, ensuring that appropriate compliance resources and training are in place.
  • Identify, assess, mitigate and control operational risks.
  • Protect sensitive customer and Bank information.

Leadership & Teamwork:

  • Set the long-term strategic vision and direction for the West Region.
  • Translate the country strategy into clear priorities and practical actions for the region.
  • Lead and motivate frontline teams to maximise their potential.
  • Develop a high-performing and customer-focused culture.
  • Lead the team in acquiring and developing appropriate customer relationships.
  • Ensure the effective delivery of customers’ transactional and financing needs.
  • Promote and demonstrate HSBC’s values and expected behaviours.
  • Establish clear succession and career development plans.
  • Identify critical roles and develop talent to support future business needs.
  • Contribute to positioning HSBC as a bank of choice for customers.

Functional Knowledge:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Desirable Master Degree
  • 10+ year of relevant leadership experience in Corporate or Middle Market segments, or equivalent.
  • Experience managing a business segment, geographical area or comparable business unit.
  • Extensive knowledge of banking products and services.
  • Demonstrated success in sales and relationship management.
  • Strong experience in customer-facing roles.
  • Strong understanding of lending, credit assessment and approval processes.

title: Project Leader, R&D QA Operations
description:
About Apotex Inc.

Apotex is a Canadian-based global health company. We improve everyday access to affordable, innovative medicines and health products for millions of people worldwide, with a broad portfolio of generic, biosimilar, innovative branded pharmaceuticals and consumer health products. Headquartered in Toronto, with regional offices globally, including in the United States, Mexico and India, we are the largest Canadian-based pharmaceutical company and a health partner of choice for the Americas for pharmaceutical licensing and product acquisitions.

For more information visit: .

Job Summary

The project Leader, R&D QA Operations is responsible for monitoring the quality of operational aspects related to Formulations Development and New Product Launch processes at the Signet Campus and Etobicoke site. The Project Leader’s core responsibilities include approval of master manufacturing/packaging records, executed batch records, change control and investigation records for non-commercial batches such as Investigational Medicinal Products (IMPs) in support of regulatory filings. This role provides leadership and mentoring to junior associates and represents R&D Quality in cross functional meetings.

Job Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary R&D QA contact for all product quality issues for non-commercial batches manufactured by Apotex Formulations Development and New Product Launch at Signet and Etobicoke sites
  • Review and approve master documentation, protocols/reports, stability protocols and associated change controls from Apotex R&D for non-commercial batches
  • Conduct impact analysis of the proposed corrective & preventative actions by engaging Apotex subject matter experts, as required
  • Establish and maintain a system to trend investigations and create visibility of quality related issues for Formulations Development and New Product Launch
  • Ensure that all manufacturing, packaging and related documents pertaining to the batch are complete, accurate and reviewed and all investigations/deviations have been closed prior to release
  • Provide support to R&D to stay abreast of regulatory inspections at their sites and assists in resolution of quality concerns arising from those inspections
  • Audit and approve executed batch records for IMPs, registration/submission and demonstration batches
  • Review, coordinate and approve activities for deviation investigations and CAPA for R&D operations
  • Coordinate and lead complaint investigations for IMPs
  • Review and approve R&D change control requests, including new SAP code creations, supplier changes, etc.
  • Provides QA approval to allow Formulations Development or New Product Development to proceed with manufacturing based upon preliminary investigation findings and root cause analysis provided all the necessary adjustments have been made to restore equipment/facilities to full operation
  • Liaises with internal customers and stake holders to review and discuss deviation root causes and proposed CAPAs for complex investigations and provides QA recommendations regarding actions such as initiating process optimization investigations with R&D operations
  • Assist in the preparation activities leading up to regulatory or customer inspections and participate during inspections to address requests
  • Review Pharmaceutical Development Reports (PDRs) and other documents required for regulatory applications/submissions
  • Perform a final overall quality review of regulatory submission documents to ensure the science/data/conclusions are sound, comply with current regulatory standards, and to ensure that submissions are of high quality, consistent and complete
  • Perform a concurrent review of critical submission documentation (e.g. QoS, Batch Records, PDR/CQA/QTPP, validation/stability reports, Specifications/CofA/Release Results, Quality/Lab Investigations, technical reports/summaries) for accuracy, completeness, compliance, appropriate content/justifications, adherence to regulatory guidelines/strategies and commitments
  • Represent R&D QA during cross functional meetings as required, including Global Project Management meetings and Product Launch meetings
  • Assist in training and mentoring junior members of the team where required
  • Works in a safe manner collaborating as a team member to achieve all outcomes
  • Demonstrate Behaviours that exhibit our organizational Values: Integrity, Courage, Teamwork, and Innovation.
  • Ensure personal adherence with all compliance programs including the Global Business Ethics and Compliance Program, Global Quality policies and procedures, Safety and Environment policies, and HR policies
  • All other relevant duties as assigned

Job Requirements

  • Education
    • B.Sc. in Chemistry or Biochemistry or in a related science
  • Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
    • Knowledge of GMP and cGMPs requirements
    • Experience with solid dose manufacturing techniques
    • Knowledge of Microsoft Office programs and laboratory LIMS systems an asset
    • Ability to effectively work both independently and in a team environment
    • Superior time management and organizational skills
    • Experience with technical report writing and scientific documents an asset
    • Clear and concise written and oral English communication skills

  • Experience
    • Minimum of 5 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, 2 years in Quality Assurance

At Apotex, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and accessible work environment, where all everyone feels valued, respected, and supported to succeed.

We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities as part of its recruitment process. If you are contacted to arrange for an interview or testing, please advise us if you require an accommodation.

The hiring range for this position is $83,958.00 - $139,930.00 CAD per year. The final agreed-upon salary may vary based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills and experience.
We are looking for top talent. If your qualifications differ from those listed above, the scope of work and final agreed-upon salary may be adjusted to reflect your individual qualifications.

The Apotex Total Rewards package goes beyond base salary. Apotex offers bonus programs based on your position in the organization, you can excel based on our pay-for-performance philosophy. With comprehensive benefits, a pension plan to help you save for retirement and learning and development opportunities, we provide a comprehensive package for your personal and professional development.


Apotex will use artificial intelligence to screen, select and/or assess your application for this job.


This job posting is for a role that is currently available and vacant at Apotex.

title: Principal Environmental Professional
description:
Professional | Full-Time | Quality, Health, Safety and Environment



At Vestas Australia, our Projects team delivers world-class renewable energy solutions that support Australia's clean energy transition. Backed by Vestas' global leadership in sustainable energy solutions and a presence in more than 80 countries, we work across development, engineering, construction, and commissioning to safely and efficiently deliver energy projects that create lasting value for our customers, communities, and the environment.

Join our team as a Principal Environmental Professional, where you will provide expert environmental leadership and strategic guidance across major renewable energy and infrastructure projects. Working closely with project, engineering, and construction teams, you will lead environmental approvals, compliance, stakeholder engagement, and risk management activities to support successful project delivery. This is an opportunity to influence environmental outcomes at a strategic level while driving best-practice sustainability and regulatory compliance throughout the project lifecycle.


Responsibilities:


• Provide effective environmental advice and support to ensure compliance with client and regulatory requirements during design, construction, and operations.
• Conduct environmental site inspections, audits, and compliance reviews to verify that contractors adhere to the Construction Environmental Management Plan and associated plans and obligations.
• Investigate environmental incidents, identify and implement corrective actions through to resolution, and escalate incidents requiring State or Commonwealth notification.
• Prepare environmental toolbox materials, site inductions, and environmental awareness resources as required.
• Prepare Construction Environmental Management Plans and other environmental documentation required for construction and operations.
• Contribute to the standardisation and simplification of environmental management processes, systems, and reporting requirements.
• Contribute to lessons learned initiatives and the sharing of innovative practices.
• Contribute to corporate sustainability reporting obligations.
• Contribute to organisational change initiatives that improve environmental performance, governance, and business integration.
• Support the effectiveness of the regional Environmental Management System in alignment with ISO 14001 requirements.
• Provide environmental advice during risk assessments, HAZCONs, design reviews, tenders, and contract negotiations with clients and subcontractors.
• Liaise effectively with clients', contractors', and consultants' environmental advisors, as well as regulators, when required.
• Ensure all work is carried out in compliance with Vestas Health, Safety and Environment requirements and in accordance with Vestas policies, objectives, and targets.



Qualifications:


• Environmental science, engineering or related




Competencies:


• ICAM investigation experience.
• Lead auditor qualification.
• Proven ability to simplify, standardise, and scale environmental processes.
• Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
• Strong understanding of environmental risk management.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint; and QGIS.
• Sound knowledge of environmental legislation.


What we offer:


• Excellent Career Development opportunities both Nationally and Globally
• A workplace that embraces Diversity and Inclusion
• Flexible workplace arrangements
• 18 weeks Paid Primary Carers Leave
• 3 weeks Paid Secondary Carers Leave

  • Join the World's Leading Wind Energy Solutions Provider
  • Excellent Career Development opportunities both Nationally and Globally
  • A workplace that embraces Diversity and Inclusion
  • Flexible workplace arrangements

  • Employee Assistance Program
